variants.name: a-balanced-road-cabin
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished 16:10 landscape PC survival game interface concept screenshot, 1600x1000 composition, fully flat screen with no monitor, no surrounding presentation board, no collage. Game title ROADSEER. Simplified Chinese labels, legible restrained typography.
Primary request: top full-width HUD; BELOW it three side-by-side areas in this exact order: LEFT vertical road scene, MIDDLE upright vehicle backpack cutaway, RIGHT contextual equipment panel. This is a vehicle inventory survival strategy game with automatic combat, NOT a racing game.
Shared scenario: first day of 14-day preparation before the seven-day Three Suns heat catastrophe. HUD text: "第 01 天", "准备期", "三日凌空 · 14 天后", "行动 1/2"; resource row "乘员 60/60", "车体 40/40", "水 6", "粮 6", "油 8", "弹 10". Small record/menu icons top right.
Road: strictly bottom-to-top direction. A battered small sage-green camper van seen from above at LOWER part of road, front facing UP. A supply crate is the one approaching encounter above the van, outlined amber and label "物资箱". Farther up a single fork/ramp leads to a modest roadside service station labeled "服务区"; horizon or distant road at upper edge. Forward white dashed road markings. Dry ruined countryside but quietly readable, no mass of enemies. No driving joystick, steering wheel HUD, race speedometer or minimap.
Inventory: enlarged same camper upright, front/windshield TOP, rear BOTTOM, orthographic top-down cutaway. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS of square cells (4x6), visibly vertical. Four seats across the first two rows, each exactly one column wide and two rows tall: driver at top-left and three passengers. Remaining lower four rows: row3-4 four 1x2 vertical blocks for blue water, muted olive food, orange fuel, brass ammo; row5-6 a 2x2 workbench on LEFT, a 1x2 mounted gun in third column and 1x2 metal stock in fourth. Show objects as attractive readable item illustrations contained in their rectangular slot footprint, subtle square sub-grid, no duplicate loose objects. Workbench selected with amber outline. Header "我的车辆" and "4×6"; small footer "点击设施使用 · 拖动物品整理". All vehicle details stay VERTICAL; never rotate this grid horizontally.
Right contextual panel: heading "制作台"; selected-item illustration; concise "已装车 · 占用 2×2"; available recipe "隔热层" with compact "减少高温伤害" and "查看配方" action, then subordinate "装甲板" and "修理包" rows. Bottom "移动" and "卸下". No giant wall of recipes, no dashboard charts. Its visual link to the selected bench must be clear.
Bottom narrow quiet footer "今晚：水 1 · 粮 1" with "结束当天 →" button at far right. No loot tray in this frame because no loot on ground.
Constraints: all three areas visible simultaneously. Functional readable game screenshot, refined indie game concept art, carefully aligned text and spacing. Generous breathing room. No brand imitation, no logos except ROADSEER, no watermark, no extra portraits, no fake game review ratings, no neon sci-fi holograms. Item art and scene art must feel from the same game. Chinese text must use exact short labels above. This is concept art, not implementation documentation.
Direction A — 道路与车厢双主角. Balanced functional hierarchy: below the HUD, road 37% width, inventory 39%, context 24%. Clear thin panel separations. Road top-down orthographic miniature landscape: quiet desaturated grass, cracked asphalt, warm crate and distant service ramp; vehicle bottom center. Vehicle cutaway large enough to read the grid effortlessly. Restrained tactile hand-painted 2D sprites with precise clean UI, dark forest green panel surfaces #14251F, warm off-white text, amber selection #E0BE7D, water cyan. Background edges matte and subtle; no grime behind text. Gentle daylight from upper-left only in world and object illustrations. Compact two-line HUD takes about 12% height; content takes 80%, footer8%. More visual detail than a wireframe but immediately plausible to implement in Godot 2D. Label tiny top-left "A / 双主角".
